practice.title: Practice

practice.sentenceHint: Complete the sentence, then check your answer
practice.recallHint: Recall the meaning before showing the answer
practice.previousSessionsEmpty: Your completed sessions will appear here.
practice.answersUnavailable: Answer details were not saved for older sessions.

settings.title: Settings
settings.remindersOn: One reminder per session, spaced outside your quiet hours.
settings.permissionDenied: Allow notifications in your phone settings.
settings.windowTooShort: The available window is too short to schedule reminders.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.csvHint: For Excel: export, keep the id column, and separate tags with |. Save as CSV UTF-8, then import.
vocabulary.addWordHint: Add the word and its translations.
vocabulary.fillRequired: Add the Hungarian word and at least one translation.
vocabulary.duplicateWords: The file contains duplicate words. Add them individually to merge them.
vocabulary.exportFailed: Could not export. Please try again.
vocabulary.importConfirm: {{count}} entries will be added or updated. Existing progress is kept by ID.
vocabulary.selectMeaningsHint: Select every meaning you want to keep.
vocabulary.removeTagsHint: Remove tags you do not want to keep.

backup.title: Backup & Data Safety
backup.hint: Save your entire vocabulary, review history, and settings to Google Drive, iCloud, or local files.
backup.confirmRestoreMessage: This will replace your current vocabulary and progress with the data in the backup file.
backup.restoreFailed: Could not restore backup. Please verify the file.

errors.invalidJson: This file is not valid JSON.
errors.invalidFile: This file is not a backup file.
errors.wrongApp: This backup belongs to a different app.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This backup was made by a different version of the app.
errors.incompleteData: The backup is incomplete or incompatible.
errors.sharingUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device.

dictionary.translationsHint: Translations come from your notes and may contain errors.
dictionary.removeConfirmMessage: “{{word}}” will no longer appear in practice. You can restore it from My words.

voice.title: Hungarian voice
voice.missing: An offline Hungarian voice is not installed. Connect to the internet to download voice data, then return here.
voice.ready: Hungarian offline voice is ready. Tap the speaker to listen.
voice.notReady: The offline Hungarian voice is not ready yet. You can check again in Settings.
voice.unavailable: A Hungarian offline voice is unavailable on this device. You can continue practicing without audio.
voice.setupUnavailable: Voice setup could not be opened. Search for text-to-speech in your phone settings and install Hungarian voice data.
voice.playbackError: Could not play the Hungarian voice. Check the voice settings and try again.

status.missing: An offline Hungarian voice is not installed.
status.unavailable: Offline voice is unavailable on this device.
